selected.convention: Decimal GB and TFLOP; max(compute time, transfer time) is an ideal lower bound with overlap and peak rates, not measured runtime. Excludes latency, caches and utilization losses.

budget.convention: A[B,D] W[D,F] -> C[B,F]; once-read A/W and once-write C. Weight-only 2B/e neglects A/C traffic and is an approximation, not the B-to-infinity limit. Finite crossing solves I(B)=peak/bandwidth; null means no finite crossing, and first integer is null also outside safe integer range. Sampled polyline, ideal peak/overlap assumptions, no measured GPU performance.
